request.task: T3B exact Fable corrections for Local teammate presentation, receipt adapter, data safety, and submit state machine
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.scenario: A 200 local envelope with a schema-valid non-complete receipt (null output/partial hashes, bound lane/effects/cost/retryEligible/teammateId) but a non-null proposal that fails proposalFrom (wrong notice/boundaries, extra garbage object, or non-object) is coerced to proposal===null because proposalFrom returns null. That path returns kind:"terminal" instead of invalid. Missing `proposal` key is likewise treated as null. Concrete input: POST success body `{..., proposal: {schemaVersion:1}, receipt: budget-exhausted/null hashes/...}` → UI shows a valid terminal receipt, not the invalid-receipt error. This breaks exact schema binding and can hide a malformed complete-ish payload behind the non-complete adapter.
findings.remediation: Treat terminal only when the envelope is local and `proposal` is strictly JSON null (and, if the contract has them, output/partial strictly null). If `proposal` is present and non-null, parse with proposalFrom; parse failure or any non-complete+proposal combination must return the invalid-receipt error. Do not use proposalFrom(null)/missing-key as success.

findings.scenario: The allowlisted change adds `selection?: PreviewSelection`, imports `../previewState`, and interpolates `selection.tag` and `selection.editId` into Agent Studio. Criterion forbids adding a selection payload (and parent is not on the allowlist, so the truthy branch is dead in this slice). Even with “not sent” copy, selection identifiers are now a panel input/UI surface the fables did not ask to add.
findings.remediation: Remove the PreviewSelection import and prop. If honesty copy is required, keep a static sentence that no Canvas selection is included in the local assignment; never accept or render selection fields.

findings.line: renders a valid non-complete receipt without marking the assignment invalid / announces a terminal proposal receipt / locks every assignment control
findings.scenario: Oracles can pass while F-03/F-08/schema binding fail. Terminal test uses `toContain("No")` which already matches “No AI model”, “No mutation”, “None”, “No placeholder…”, so retryEligible is not proven. Complete-result test never requires the “Placeholder proposal” heading or the no-model notice on the result surface, so a real-model “Proposal”/“Proposed by” regression still passes. No test feeds a non-null invalid proposal with a non-complete receipt (the HIGH path). Working submit only checks `not.toContain("disabled=\"\"")`, so `disabled="true"`/`disabled="disabled"` would false-green F-08. Duplicate-guard (`submitting.current`) and focus-stability are untested (static markup).
findings.remediation: Assert exact terminal dl text (e.g. Retry eligible → No), exact result heading “Placeholder proposal” plus the no-model notice in result/working/error, adapter cases for missing proposal key and non-null unparsable proposal with non-complete receipts expecting kind:"error", and the working submit tag as natively enabled (`<button type="submit"` without any disabled attr) with aria-disabled="true". Add a synchronous double-submit unit around createProposal/submitting.

audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied beyond the diff. Assertions in AiTeammatePanel.test.tsx were treated as claims, not evidence; several are substring-weak and never execute createProposal, unmount/abort, or the invalid-proposal+non-complete adapter path.
residual_risks: AiTeammateRunReceiptV1Schema is outside the slice; if non-complete statuses may legally set retryEligible true or non-null partial/output hashes, isBoundReceipt still classifies them as invalid (false invalid) or, conversely, any Zod-success status other than complete is labeled a valid terminal run.
In-flight fetch is not aborted on unmount; only generation/mounted commit guards apply.
Focus stability when the focused textarea/select/radio becomes disabled on submit is browser-dependent and unverified.
